legacy_pick.title: Old AppDaemon/MQTT bridge
legacy_pick.description: Several installations of the old AppDaemon/MQTT bridge were found. Choose the one belonging to this device to take over its history, or "-" to skip.

legacy.title: Transfer old AppDaemon values first
legacy.description:
Data of the old AppDaemon/MQTT bridge **{client_id}** was found. It is transferred **before** the integration starts writing its own values.

**1. Taken over ({count})**: the new entities get these entity IDs, so history, long-term statistics, energy dashboard costs, dashboards and automations continue:

| Old entity | New entity | Last value | Statistics |
|---|---|---|---|
{table}

**2. Further old statistics** (e.g. older English names), merged into the entities above:

| Old statistic | Into | Period | Hours |
|---|---|---|---|
{statistics}

**3. Costs (energy dashboard)**, transferred:

| Old cost statistic | Into | Period | Hours | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
{costs}

Not transferable (removed, history stays in the database): {skipped}

**Stop the AppDaemon app / getjudo service before you continue.** Old statistics are kept. Create a backup first.

error.no_devices: No device found in this account
error.bridge_running: The old bridge is still sending values. Stop the AppDaemon app (or the getjudo service) first, wait until its entities are unavailable and try again.
